## Observed pattern: fill gaps in repeated marker rows
A demonstrated task used a uniform background (3) and a marker color (8) appearing every other column along horizontal row segments. Preserve markers, background outside such gaps, and all other rows. For the observed alternating-marker examples, gaps were single cells. Do not connect markers vertically or diagonally.
